EC1: Subject has indeterminate, ulcerative, antibiotic-associated colitis.
EC2: Subject has stool positive for ova and parasite and for Clostridium difficule toxins within 3 months prior to enrollment.
EC3: Subject with other known infectious cause of abdominal symptoms.
EC4: Subject with clinical evidence of renal disease with the past 6 months, defined as estimated glomerular filtration rate (GFR) outside the normal reference range.
EC5: Subject with known history of intestinal obstruction [OR] or current obstructive symptoms, such as severe abdominal pain with accompanying nausea [OR] or vomiting, based on investigator judgment.
EC6: Subject with a diagnosis of gastroparesis [OR] or small bowel [OR] or large bowel dysmotility.
EC7: Subjects with a history of small bowel [OR] or colonic resection.
EC8: Subject with any current condition believed to have an increased risk of capsule retention such as suspected or known bowel obstruction, stricture, or fistula.
EC9: Subject has used non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs including aspirin, two times per week, during the 4 weeks preceding enrollment. Low dose aspirin regimens (< 100 mg daily) are acceptable and not exclusionary.
EC10: Subject suffers from any condition, such as swallowing problems, that [NOT] precludes compliance with [OR] study and/or device instructions.
EC11: Subject with cardiac pacemaker [OR] or other implanted electromedical device.
EC12: Subject has an allergy [OR] or other known contraindication [AND] to the medications used in the study.
EC13: Subject is pregnant (documented by a positive pregnancy test) [OR] or is actively breast-feeding.
EC14: Subject is considered to be a part of a vulnerable population (eg. prisoners [OR] or those without sufficient mental capacity).
EC15: Subject has a known contraindication to MRE [OR] or IC.
EC16: Subject has participated in a drug or device research study within 30 days of enrollment that may interfere with the subject's safety or ability to participate in the study.
EC17: Subject has any medical condition that would make it unsafe for them to participate, per Investigator's descretion
